questions.q: Why can't you bind to a COM port number?
options: Windows prohibits access by port number
The number changes after a reboot
questions.explain: Identical boards share one VID/PID, and the number changes after a reboot. Find the drone by its craft_name, read over MSP (MSP_NAME).

questions.q: What does exit noreboot do in Betaflight 4.5.0–4.5.3?
questions.explain: The noreboot argument appeared in 4.5.4; in 2025.12 `exit noreboot` and `save noreboot` really do work without a reboot. To peek at a value, just close the port.

questions.q: After set + save the value turned out different. Why?
options: The port was held by another program during the write
questions.explain: Betaflight corrects incompatible combinations at boot. The rule: after save, re-read every changed value with get.

questions.q: What must a script do right after save?
options: Send diff once more to confirm the write
Find the port by craft_name again
questions.explain: After a reboot the COM port may change its number; find the board again by craft_name over MSP.

questions.q: Why diff and not dump for storage?
options: dump cannot be saved to a text file
diff is only the differences from the defaults
questions.explain: A diff is readable and portable; a dump forces the old defaults as explicit values on an update.

questions.q: What is safe to automate with a CLI script?
options: Downloading diff all and checking values after save
Choosing PIDs by the pilot's feel after every flight
The decision to clear a drone for flight
Flashing the bootloader instead of DFU
questions.explain: Routine work with a verifiable result — yes; decisions and risky operations — no.

questions.q: Carrying a diff from an old major version to a new one:
options: Requires checking: setting names and meanings change
questions.explain: Settings are renamed and changed between versions; a diff is checked, not pasted blindly.

questions.q: How does a script enter Betaflight's CLI mode?
options: Presses the BOOT button on the board
Sends the # character to the serial port
Opens the CLI tab in the configurator
questions.explain: The # character puts the firmware into the CLI; from there commands are plain text.
